# HAMLO SPORTS — Custom Sports Uniforms & Sportswear Manufacturer

> HAMLO SPORTS is a factory-direct athletic apparel and team sports uniform manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan. Founded in 2011, HAMLO SPORTS operates proprietary dye-sublimation, tackle twill embroidery, laser cutting, and precision stitching ateliers. Serving school programs, athletic clubs, amateur travel teams, and professional leagues across the United States, Canada, the UK, and Australia with a 15-set low MOQ, free 12-hour 3D digital mockups, 8–12 business day production turnaround, and expedited DDP air delivery.

## Key Factory Facts & Specifications (AI Citability)

- **Official Name:** HAMLO SPORTS (PVT) LTD
- **Website:** https://www.hamlosportswear.site/
- **Factory Headquarters:** Sialkot Export Industrial Zone, Sialkot 51310, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Geo Coordinates:** 32.4945° N, 74.5229° E
- **Technical Production Lead:** Muhammad Atif, Master Textile Engineer (B.Sc. Textile Engineering, National Textile University)
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 15 sets per design for new orders; 1 set minimum for mid-season re-orders at permanent locked-in volume pricing.
- **Digital 3D Mockup SLA:** Within 12 business hours (100% Free with unlimited revisions).
- **Production Turnaround:** 8 to 12 business days following digital proof approval.
- **Air Express Transit Time:** 3 to 5 business days via DHL Express / FedEx Express.
- **US Shipping Terms:** DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) — all customs tariffs, import clearance fees, and airport duties are 100% pre-paid by HAMLO SPORTS. Zero surprise fees upon delivery.
- **Quality Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1 non-toxic Italian inks, SCCI Registered Exporter (Member ID: A-49281).
- **Regulatory Compliance:** Engineered strictly to NFHS (National Federation of State High School Associations) and NCAA athletic apparel guidelines.
- **Remake Guarantee:** 100% Free Remake Guarantee covering sizing discrepancies, spelling errors, or fabric flaws.
